integration_decision.name: SAME_CLOCK_IS_NOT_GENERATION_IDENTITY
integration_decision.source_verified: At pinned HEAD, runner writes latest.json, audit_latest.json, anata_latest.json as three independent atomic writes. All three expose as_of_ms (output.to_dict, frame.to_audit_dict, build_anata_handoff); archive lock is confined to storage operations.
integration_decision.oracle_limit: Equal final as_of_ms is a timestamp-level check, not proof that files come from the same generation if overlapping writers use the same as_of_ms but different visible archive states. Sequential two-child preflight does not exercise this.
integration_decision.disposition: Do not weaken existing contract or claim a defect. Retain frozen distinct-clock two-writer contract; when executable evidence is available, add a deterministic same-clock, different-source-row identity/coverage assertion for persisted outputs only if all three outputs expose an unambiguous comparable observable. No code edits or new speculative Gemini task now.
integration_decision.next: Obtain approved exact-SHA checkout or authorized sanitized executor diagnostics.
